The positive fixture models the retained password retries and Socket.IO MFA commands specified by Island's Behind the Connect Button report (2026-10-06). Expect retained-password-retries-socket-export and operator-controlled-mfa-retry-flow. The ordinary login fixture submits both factors to its own login endpoint; neither new composite should fire. These traits detect co-occurrence, not proven data flow. Exact command spellings cover reuse of the documented protocol; renamed protocols remain a coverage limitation.
